name: Research to Social | AI Drafts, Telegram Approval & LinkedIn Publishing

parameters.content:
### 1. Setup

Set the Sheet ID, Telegram chat ID, and Cloudflare account ID in both config nodes. Select your personal profile in Publish LinkedIn. Use separate API credentials for Firecrawl, Groq, and Cloudflare.

### 3. Research and Draft

Firecrawl finds sources. Groq uses them to write two different LinkedIn and X posts, with image prompts. Posts use no emojis; LinkedIn drafts end with 3–4 relevant hashtags.

### 5. Publishing and records

After approval, the workflow downloads the selected preview image from Telegram and publishes it with the chosen post to LinkedIn. X copy is sent to Telegram for manual posting.

parameters.content:
### 2. Topic queue

Add topics to the Topics sheet with a unique topic_id and status=queued. The workflow processes one topic at a time and waits for a decision before taking another.

### 4. Telegram review

The bot sends both drafts and images. Regenerate queues the topic for another run; Skip closes it. Neither button publishes. Publish A/B starts the LinkedIn branch.
